title: 병원 접수처에서 진단서 요청하기: 진단서 좀 떼어 주세요
objective: You can ask for a medical certificate with -아/어 주세요 and say where you will submit it.
summary: A patient asks a clinic receptionist for a medical certificate.
setting: The reception desk of a neighborhood clinic, just after seeing the doctor.

task.title: Ask for your certificate
task.line: Use the dialogue and word list to make requests and answer the receptionist.

words.exampleMeaning: I got two copies of the medical certificate.
I got a document issued at the community center.
Hand in your homework by Friday.
I get to work by nine.
I left my ID at home.

words.meaning: in English (for a document or name)
words.exampleMeaning: My name is written in English in my passport.

dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, could I get a medical certificate, please?
Sure. Where will you submit it?

dialogue.korean: 회사에 내야 해요. 감기 때문에 3일 동안 출근을 못 했어요.
dialogue.meaning: I have to give it to my company. I couldn't go to work for 3 days because of a cold.
I see. Please show me your ID.

dialogue.korean: 여기 있어요. 혹시 영어로도 써 주실 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Here it is. Could you also write it in English, by any chance?

dialogue.korean: 네, 영문 진단서도 돼요. 비용은 따로 내셔야 해요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, we can do an English certificate too. You have to pay for it separately.

exercises: Make a polite request with -아/어/해 주세요: ① 서류를 복사하다 ② 날짜를 고치다 ③ 한 장 더 뽑다
Answer in Korean. The receptionist asks: 어디에 내실 거예요? You need to submit the certificate to your school.
Fill in the blank with a word from the list: 열이 나서 이틀 동안 ____을 못 했어요.
Put the words in order to make a request: 있어요? / 한 장 더 / 수 / 뽑아 / 주실
Read the dialogue again. Write O (true) or X (false): ① 마이클 씨는 감기 때문에 회사에 못 갔어요. ② 영문 진단서는 비용이 없어요. ③ 마이클 씨는 직원에게 신분증을 보여 줬어요.
answers: ① 서류를 복사해 주세요. ② 날짜를 고쳐 주세요. ③ 한 장 더 뽑아 주세요.
한 장 더 뽑아 주실 수 있어요?
① O ② X ③ O
